challenge.method: Tested a subsequent release of a different Modification, outsourcing hosting, and using the identical §3.2 excerpt digest to identify the whole edition.
challenge.results: A different Modification does not satisfy the six-month condition. You retain responsibility when a third party hosts the source. The complete MPL 1.1 capture and its definitions bind the edition despite the shared §3.2 bytes.

limitations: The electronic route requires at least 12 months after initial availability, or at least six months after a subsequent version of that particular Modification is made available to those recipients. Section 4 separately addresses impossibility due to statute, judicial order or regulation.
